11.t: Working with data: angles of reflection
q: What was the angle of reflection at 30 °?
What pattern do the results show?
The angle of reflection is about equal to the angle of incidence.
Suggest why some results differ by 1 or 2 degrees.
The ray is wide, marking crosses is imprecise, protractor reading errors.
Suggest two improvements to the method.
Use a narrow slit, mark rays with two crosses far apart, use a sharp pencil, repeat and average.
